requirements.gap: The weekly schedule contract, stale gate, baseline consistency, and recovery path are exercised and refresh runs are recorded with 114-step pass telemetry, but sustained unattended operation over the scheduled two-year cadence is not yet demonstrated.

Rights and publisher dependence remain unverified for all source families; the rights-assignment queue now makes the eight-family ownership work explicit, and the candidate independence adjudication queue makes all five candidate reviews assignable with 4 high-priority rows. Candidate-specific reviews cover the monitored food-security lane, the mobility comparison, and 7 financial-room sources. The uncertainty coverage audit makes source-level, incomplete, and pending uncertainty visible across six decision-facing artifacts. The 500-industry IBIS sample and six-force review expose repeated source IDs, URLs, missing claim periods, and metadata gaps for dependency review; the claim-independence audit mechanically flags reused URLs, hosts, and publishers, the review queue turns the remaining low-dependency claims into assigned work, the first ten-claim packet is now fully triaged with 10 conservative held dispositions and 0 pending rows, rather than unsupported promotion. Upstream redistribution and enterprise rights approval remain open. The SHED point estimate has only a non-release naive interval and design-based variance remains open.

The compatibility scan now finds 209 cross-host measure groups and the release includes bounded food-insecurity, mobility-access, OECD/UN DESA/World Bank, and a same-publisher CBP-versus-NES repair measurement comparison. Distinct-publisher comparisons remain non-comparable holdouts because populations, reference periods, uncertainty, weighting, and rights differ; the Census repair comparison explicitly cannot count as independent confirmation, and no common-unit observed holdout has passed.

The food-insecurity candidate has a descriptive Urban 2019–2023 to 2024–2025 holdout and non-pooled USDA challenge; the mobility lane has a bounded ACS 2023→2024 holdout plus an independent NHTS directional challenge; and the IBIS adult-day-care lane has a dated CDC outcome series plus a CMS Medicaid rate comparison. The cell-phone repair lane now has reproducible 2019–2023 paid-employee CBP and 2019–2024 nonemployer Census proxies, but neither is phone-specific and they cannot be pooled with policy or e-waste evidence. Causal validation, uncertainty harmonization, independent utilization outcomes, and holdouts for the other candidates remain open.
Reader surface exposes the qualified external food-insecurity pattern and held candidates, but no validated company outcome is published.

The handoff records six roles, a reconciled ownership-assignment queue, and a reproducible read-only successor-validation artifact; named human ownership, an independently signed successor run, and sustained weekly continuity are still outstanding.

No pilot is approved because a company decision contract, named rights owner, internal exposure definition, and privacy review are still required after external monitoring; the fail-closed bridge and external-only release gates are exercised.

boundary: This audit is a conservative program status report. It does not redefine the goal as complete because the control plane and frontend are operational.
next_action: Use evidence-acquisition-plan.json to close the independent compatible holdout and rights gates, then re-run this audit before any internal bridge.
